releasedVersion.description: A specific released version only -- not 'main'. Used where the value must be a fixed baseline comparable against future releases (see last_checked_version below), unlike added_version/deprecated_version/removed_version where 'main' legitimately means 'happened on the dev branch, not yet released'.

compatibility.description: Object keyed by stack, then by 'default' or a variant name. Stack/variant key validity against schema/vocab.json is checked by scripts/validate.py, not by this schema. Used by messages/enums; commands use commandCompatibility below instead.

frameStatus.description: compatibility.<stack>.frames.<frame> for a command doc (context: mission/command only). No 'default' fallback -- every field here is that frame's own explicit fact.

params.description: Keyed by '<index>_<name>' matching the command's top-level params object. Present only if this frame's own 'supported' is a confirmed-implemented object -- see scripts/validate.py's check_frame_status.

sentinel_compliance.description: Does this frame correctly enforce the sentinel-value contract (unused param NACKs any non-sentinel value; used param tolerates the sentinel)? Keyed by 'default' (required) plus optional '<index>_<name>' overrides for params that diverge from the default -- gated the same way as 'params'.

mav_frames.description: Coordinate-frame (MAV_FRAME) support for this vehicle frame -- deliberately a separate key from the vehicle-type 'frames' above, since they're unrelated MAVLink concepts that happen to share an English name.

commandFrames.description: compatibility.<stack>.frames for a command doc. {} = untested, nothing evaluated for any frame yet. false = confirmed unsupported on every frame (a blanket negative fact -- see sibling basis/notes/last_checked_version on the enclosing commandStackStatus). Object = per-frame breakdown keyed by a frame name from schema/vocab.json's frames list for that stack. No 'default' fallback -- every known frame is written out explicitly.

commandStackStatus.description: compatibility.<stack> for a command doc. basis/notes/impl_url/last_checked_version here describe the blanket 'frames: false' case only; when frames is an object each frame carries its own -- enforced by scripts/validate.py, not this schema.

commandCompatibility.description: compatibility for command docs (context: mission/command). Object keyed by stack -> commandStackStatus. Distinct from 'compatibility' above, which messages/enums still use (variant-keyed default+override). Stack key validity against schema/vocab.json is checked by scripts/validate.py, not by this schema.
